title: Interlanguage and Mathematical Translation Methodology Sidecar (Grouped Source-Body Update)
description:
This record preserves the interlanguage and constructed-language methodology sidecar for the Modern LaTeX Manuscripts project: Interslavic and Slavic translation governance, weighted automaton and term-weight ledgers, CJK/Arabic/RTL/Persianate source-body support packages, and Claude/ChatGPT/Fable provenance materials.

Read first: 00_Interlanguage_Methodology_Current_20260706.pdf. This version keeps the July 6 front files and adds grouped side-branch payloads from origin/codex/noether-pc-20260629: Slavic/Noether-Slavic source bodies, Romance+CJK bodies, RTL/Persianate/Arabic bodies, Turkic/Indigenous/SEA/OLP bodies, and Fable/method/transfer-audit material. The companion 09 files provide a public inventory, manifest, and checksums.

Status caveat. This is methodology, source-body, provenance, and corpus-infrastructure material. It is not a certified language edition, not native-speaker approval, not accepted terminology, not source-fidelity certification, and not proof that any language branch is complete. Generated draft material may propose terms and expose inconsistencies, but source-body and independent/native witness status remain separate from generated translation status.

GitHub. Corrections, added source bodies, better weighting heuristics, and cleaned language-branch packages can be suggested via issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Human-readable interlanguage/source-body update: PDF overview first, existing provenance/weighted-automaton/baseline payloads preserved, side-branch source bodies grouped into five coherent ZIPs, plus manifest/checksums/status. Not a language-certification or critical-edition claim.
